newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Van den Broek confirms steel-oil arrangement.
newsitem.headline: Van den Broek confirms steel-oil arrangement.

text.p: The European Union has agreed to let Poland maintain protection for its oil and steel sectors until the year 2000, a European Commission spokesman said on Tuesday.

The decision, reached on December 18 by the Commission, was announced in a letter faxed by External Relations Commissioner Hans van den Broek to Polish Foreign Minister Dariusz Rosati on December 27 after the go ahead by EU ministers, the spokesman said.
The sensitive sectors are given special treatment under the terms of an association accord between Poland and the Union which serves as a stepping stone to EU membership by Warsaw.
Van den Broek also signalled the EU's intention to consider extending by three to five years the number of years during which Polish steel mills could get state aid.
